title: Doc/Documentation Fees Excluded from Advertised Price
quote: Found in bottom-of-page disclaimer text on vlp: "...government fees and taxes, any finance charges, any dealer documentation fee..."
recommendation: The disclaimer states doc fees are not included in the advertised price. Under CA VC §11713.1(e), doc/documentation fees are NOT exempt and must be included in the total advertised price. Only government fees (tax, registration, smog transfer) may be excluded.

title: Lease due-at-signing amount may not include first payment
quote: $2895 due at signing. Plus Tax, Title, License, and First Payment.
statute: CA Vehicle Code §11713.16(a)(6); Reg M 12 CFR §1013.4
recommendation: The lease disclosure states '$2895 due at signing' but then lists 'First Payment' as an additional charge ('Plus Tax, Title, License, and First Payment'). Under Regulation M and California law, the total due at signing must include all amounts the consumer pays at lease inception, including the first monthly payment. If the $2,895 does not include the $199 first payment, the actual due-at-signing is $3,094. Revise to state the complete total amount due at signing inclusive of first payment, or clarify that the $2,895 already includes the first payment.

title: Rebate stacking disclosure lacks specificity
quote: Selling Price may include dealer and manufacturer rebates, incentives, and/or bonuses that may have qualification and/or restrictions. Ask dealer for details.
recommendation: The disclaimer acknowledges that the selling price may include rebates and incentives with qualifications, but does not identify which specific rebates are included (e.g., loyalty, conquest, military, college grad, NMAC financing bonus). While the generic disclosure provides some protection, best practice is to list each rebate included in the advertised price along with its qualification criteria so consumers can determine if they qualify for the advertised price.

title: Monthly payment ad does not disclose total amount payable (CARS Act preparation)
quote:
Monthly Payment $455/mo
Duration: 75 months
Down Payment: $0
APR: 4.59%
recommendation: The VDP prominently displays monthly payment amounts ($455/mo for 75 months) but does not state the total amount payable over the loan term (approximately $34,125). The CARS Act (SB 766), effective October 1, 2026, will require that any advertisement showing a monthly payment must also clearly and conspicuously disclose the total amount payable. Begin updating payment displays now to include total payable amounts before the October 1 effective date.

title: No 3-day cancellation right reference on used vehicle page (CARS Act preparation)
quote: Used inventory with 39 vehicles. Brands include Audi, Buick, INFINITI, Nissan, Tesla.
recommendation: The used vehicle inventory page does not reference the 3-day cancellation right for used vehicles under $50,000 that the CARS Act (SB 766) establishes, effective October 1, 2026. While the primary disclosure is a separate document provided at point of sale, proactively adding a brief reference on used vehicle pages (e.g., 'Qualifying used vehicles include a 3-day return right per CA Civil Code §1784.40') demonstrates compliance readiness and transparency. No contradictory language (e.g., 'all sales final') was found, which is positive.

title: Most lead forms lack privacy link or notice at collection

recommendation: **NEEDS HUMAN REVIEW AND VERIFICATION** — The automated crawl detected 5 lead forms on the homepage, but only 1 includes a privacy policy link. None include a notice at collection.
